description: Wraps PATCH /api/experiences/{slug}/publish. Make an experience you own public in the catalog, or return it to draft. Publishing is public: confirm with the person you work for first.

published.description: true publishes the experience to the catalog; false returns it to draft.

starts_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 time when a published experience becomes visible.

name: publish_experience
title: Publish or unpublish
